source: <button class="context-toggle-btn" onclick="toggleContextPanel()" title="Show / hide the context summary panel">
<button class="context-toggle-btn" onclick="clearLocalChatData()" title="Clear only browser display preferences. Case data is retained in the secure workspace.">
<textarea id="chatInput" rows="1" placeholder="Describe your case or type / for commands..." onkeydown="handleChatKeypress(event)" oninput="handleChatInput(this)"></textarea>
<button type="button" class="panel-tab active" data-panel="input" role="tab" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="panelInput" onclick="switchPanel('input', this)">
<button type="button" class="panel-tab" data-panel="metrics" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="panelMetrics" onclick="switchPanel('metrics', this)">
<button type="button" class="panel-tab" data-panel="viewers" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="panelViewers" onclick="switchPanel('viewers', this)">
<button type="button" class="panel-tab" data-panel="report" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="panelReport" onclick="switchPanel('report', this)">
<input type="text" class="form-input" id="ctPath" placeholder="/path/to/ct.nii.gz · .dcm · DICOM folder" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'){event.preventDefault();loadCTToViewers(this.value);}">
<button class="file-btn" title="Pick a CT file (.nii/.nii.gz/.mha/.nrrd/.dcm); multi-select DICOM slices together" onclick="document.getElementById('fileCT').click()">📁 Browse</button>
<button class="file-btn" title="Pick a DICOM folder (supports extensionless DICOM files)" onclick="document.getElementById('fileCTFolder').click()">🗁 Folder</button>
<input type="file" id="fileCTFolder" webkitdirectory multiple hidden onchange="handleFileSelect(this, 'ctPath')">
<button class="btn btn-outline" id="monitorStartButton" onclick="startTrainingMode('Monitor manual/automatic planning')" data-i18n-zh="开始监测" data-i18n-en="Monitor">Monitor</button>
<button class="btn btn-outline" id="monitorStopButton" onclick="stopTrainingMode()" data-i18n-zh="结束监测" data-i18n-en="Finish Monitor" disabled>Finish Monitor</button>
<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="addManualNeedle()" data-i18n-zh="添加穿刺针" data-i18n-en="Add Needle">Add Needle</button>
<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="addManualSeed()" data-i18n-zh="添加粒子" data-i18n-en="Add Seed">Add Seed</button>
<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="recomputeManualDose('manual_button')" data-i18n-zh="重新计算 AI 剂量" data-i18n-en="Recompute AI Dose">Recompute AI Dose</button>
<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="replanManualPlan()" data-i18n-zh="重新规划几何" data-i18n-en="Replan Geometry">Replan Geometry</button>
<button class="btn btn-outline" id="generateSurgicalGuideButton" onclick="generateSurgicalGuide()" data-i18n-zh="生成导板" data-i18n-en="Generate Guide" disabled>Generate Guide</button>
<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="exportSurgicalGuideSTL()" data-i18n-zh="导出导板 STL" data-i18n-en="Export Guide STL">Export Guide STL</button>
<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="requestPlanningAdvice()" data-i18n-zh="详细建议" data-i18n-en="Detailed Advice">Detailed Advice</button>
<button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="checkSystemReadiness()" data-i18n-zh="就绪检查" data-i18n-en="Readiness">Readiness</button>

<button class="btn btn-outline" type="button" onclick="document.getElementById('guideStlValidationFile').click()" data-i18n-zh="校验导入的 STL" data-i18n-en="Validate Imported STL">Validate Imported STL</button>

<button class="btn btn-outline guide-reset-button" type="button" onclick="resetSurgicalGuideControls()" data-i18n-zh="恢复默认参数" data-i18n-en="Restore Default Parameters">Restore Default Parameters</button>

<input type="number" id="viewerWindow" value="400" step="10" style="width:50px;background:var(--bg-3);border:1px solid var(--card-border);border-radius:4px;color:var(--text);font-size:0.65rem;padding:2px 4px;" onchange="applyViewerSettings()">

<input type="number" id="viewerLevel" value="40" step="10" style="width:50px;background:var(--bg-3);border:1px solid var(--card-border);border-radius:4px;color:var(--text);font-size:0.65rem;padding:2px 4px;" onchange="applyViewerSettings()">
<input type="range" id="viewerZoom" min="50" max="300" value="100" step="10" style="width:60px;" oninput="applyZoom(this.value)"

<button class="file-btn" id="doseTextureToggle" style="padding:2px 6px;font-size:0.6rem;white-space:nowrap;" onclick="toggleDoseTextureMode()" title="Map dose intensity onto CTV/OAR 3D surfaces">Dose Surface</button>

<button class="file-btn" id="doseColorbarButton" style="padding:2px 6px;font-size:0.6rem;white-space:nowrap;" onclick="toggleDoseColorbarPanel()" title="Adjust dose colorbar ranges and palette">Dose Scale</button>
Dose Colorbar
<button hidden class="file-btn" style="padding:2px 6px;font-size:0.6rem;color:#4ade80;" onclick="setViewerTool('sat3d_positive')" id="toolSat3dPositive" title="SAT3D positive point">SAT3D +</button>
<button hidden class="file-btn" style="padding:2px 6px;font-size:0.6rem;color:#fb7185;" onclick="setViewerTool('sat3d_negative')" id="toolSat3dNegative" title="SAT3D negative point">SAT3D -</button>
<button hidden class="file-btn" style="padding:2px 6px;font-size:0.6rem;" onclick="clearSat3dPromptPoints()" id="toolSat3dClear" title="Clear SAT3D points">Clear pts</button>
<button class="file-btn layout-btn" data-layout="vertical" onclick="setViewerLayout('vertical')" title="1 column" style="padding:2px 5px;font-size:0.6rem;">☰</button>
<button class="file-btn layout-btn" data-layout="horizontal" onclick="setViewerLayout('horizontal')" title="1 row" style="padding:2px 5px;font-size:0.6rem;">☷</button>
<button class="file-btn layout-btn" data-layout="grid" onclick="setViewerLayout('grid')" title="2x2 Grid" style="padding:2px 5px;font-size:0.6rem;">▦</button>
<button class="file-btn layout-btn active" data-layout="3d-top" onclick="setViewerLayout('3d-top')" title="3D top + 3 viewers (default)" style="padding:2px 5px;font-size:0.6rem;">▲</button>
<button class="file-btn layout-btn" data-layout="3d-bottom" onclick="setViewerLayout('3d-bottom')" title="3 viewers + 3D" style="padding:2px 5px;font-size:0.6rem;">▼</button>
<input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="50" id="sliderAxial" oninput="updateSlice('axial', this.value)">
<input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="50" id="sliderSagittal" oninput="updateSlice('sagittal', this.value)">
<input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="50" id="sliderCoronal" oninput="updateSlice('coronal', this.value)">
<button class="file-btn" style="padding:2px 5px;font-size:0.55rem;" onclick="reset3DView()" title="Reset camera">↻ Reset</button>

<input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="40" id="doseOpacity" oninput="updateDoseOpacity(this.value)">
